storyCards.headline: Gloria: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Laura Branigan's "Gloria" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Gloria" (Italian pronunciation: [ˈɡlɔːrja]) is a 1979 song written and composed in Italian by Umberto Tozzi and Giancarlo Bigazzi, and first translated to English by Jonathan King.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 36 weeks on the chart.

Gloria was released in 1982.
